title: NocturneMC | Towny
description: Towny Survival SMP with light RPG mechanics
body:
![nocturne mc header banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/322054260e159f93643396c6ed7fa828aeddebf2.png)

NocturneMC is a classic towny survival server with familiar features like dungeons, economy, and community based gameplay. 

### Towny
Our server uses a custom fork of OxyTowns, a modern towny variant tailored for Nocturne specifically with integrations for our current and planned features. 
### Dungeons
Dungeons offer a chance to party up and tackle bosses and mobs in tough environments. We're currently working on a brand new dungeon featuring variable gravity! 
### Custom Items 
Like many servers, ours have lots of new items - including equipable gear, attributes, and we'll be expanding into magical abilities with combat/pvp mechanics. 

## Roadmap
A quick look at our roadmap of features! Many of these are internally developed and truly custom. 
- Custom Fishing » dynamic fishing system accounting for time of day, weather, moonphase, etc.
- Custom Gardening » empowered by mixins, our farming system closely resembles vanilla gameplay with some magical new additions. 
- Procedural Dungeons » a complex dungeoneering system designed for fresh content on demand with customizable difficulties and settings.
